verdict.rationale: Rollbar ships its own official MCP server (stdio), which lets AI tools such as Claude or Cursor drive Rollbar, so users can query and operate it in natural language through an external AI client. The Resolve AI agent turns production errors into reviewable pull requests, but it is not documented as a general natural-language command interface. Missing for 10: a native in-product natural-language command interface, documentation of which operations the MCP tools cover (read-only vs. write actions like resolving or assigning items), and hands-on or independent corroboration.
